description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Role overview**
-----------------


We are seeking a skilled and motivated Applications Development Programmer Analyst to join our global Technology team. In this collaborative role, you will contribute to the design, development, and implementation of robust, high\-performance software applications. Utilizing your expertise in Java, React, and Oracle database technologies, you will solve complex technical challenges, optimize system functionality, and deliver high\-quality solutions that support our core business operations.


**Key responsibilities**
------------------------


* **Full\-stack development:**Design, build, and maintain responsive front\-end user interfaces using React and secure, scalable back\-end services using Java.
* **Database management:**Design, optimize, and maintain relational database schemas, complex queries, and stored procedures within Oracle databases.
* **Software development lifecycle:**Participate actively in all phases of the development process, including systems analysis, technical design, coding, testing, implementation, and post\-deployment support.
* **Systems analysis and planning:**Conduct feasibility studies, prepare time and cost estimates, and contribute to risk technology and IT planning initiatives.
* **Security and compliance:**Recommend and implement robust security measures during system design and post\-implementation reviews to safeguard client and firm assets.
* **Collaboration and consulting:**Partner with business users, clients, and cross\-functional technology groups to analyze requirements, recommend advanced programming solutions, and resolve technical issues.
* **Mentorship:**Serve as a technical advisor and coach to junior analysts, promoting best practices and fostering team growth.
* **Risk management:**Appropriately assess risk when making technical and business decisions, ensuring compliance with applicable policies, laws, and regulations.

**Technical skills and qualifications**
---------------------------------------


* **Experience:** 7\+ years of professional experience in software applications programming and systems analysis.
* **Front\-end expertise:**Strong proficiency in React, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern front\-end build tools.
* **Back\-end expertise:**Deep understanding of Java, Spring Boot, or equivalent back\-end frameworks, and microservices architecture.
* **Database expertise:**Solid hands\-on experience with Oracle SQL, PL/SQL, and database performance tuning.
* **Methodologies:**Working knowledge of software development methodologies, project management techniques, and systems analysis.
* **Problem solving:**Proven ability to analyze complex technical problems, exercise independent judgment, and deliver under tight deadlines.
* **Education:**Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).

title: React Developer
description:
SourceTrace is a global leader in providing digital solutions to agriculture and food businesses. We enable full visibility into the agricultural and food value chain, with touchpoints across every stage – from farm to retail. Our SAAS solution and agri value chain management software make farming sustainable, supply chains efficient and bring transparency and traceability into food trade across 37 countries.

We are looking for a **React Developer with 1–3 years of experience** to join our development team. The primary focus of this role will be building and maintaining modern web applications using **React.js**.

Candidates with additional backend experience in **Go or Java Spring Boot** will be preferred, as the role may involve working closely with backend services and APIs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain web applications using **React.js**

Required Skills

* **1–3 years of professional experience in React.js**
* Good knowledge of **JavaScript**
* Basic to good knowledge of **TypeScript**
* Good understanding of:
* React Components
* React Hooks
* State management
* React Router
* REST API integration
* Form handling
* Good knowledge of **HTML5 and CSS3**
* Understanding of responsive web design
* Experience with **Git**
* Basic understanding of frontend debugging and browser developer tools

Good to Have

**React \+ Spring Boot**

* Basic knowledge of Java and Spring Boot
* Experience working with REST APIs
* Basic understanding of JPA/Hibernate
* PostgreSQL or other relational databases

**OR**

**React \+ Go**

* Basic knowledge of Go/Golang
* Experience working with REST APIs
* PostgreSQL or other relational databases

Additional knowledge of **Docker, AWS, Jenkins/CI\-CD** will be an advantage.

Preferred Candidate

We are looking for a **frontend\-focused developer** who is interested in understanding the complete application stack.

**Strong preference:**

* React \+ Spring Boot
* React \+ Go

However, **strong React experience alone is also acceptable** if the candidate has a willingness to learn backend technologies.

Ideal Profile

* Strong fundamentals in React and JavaScript
* Good problem\-solving skills
* Able to understand an existing codebase
* Willing to work with backend APIs
* Good communication and teamwork
* Eager to learn and take ownership of assigned features

**Primary Skill:** React.js  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Preferred:** React \+ Spring Boot / React \+ Go

* Build reusable and maintainable React components
* Integrate React applications with **REST APIs**
* Implement responsive and user\-friendly interfaces
* Work with backend developers to integrate frontend and backend services
* Debug and resolve application issues
* Write clean, readable, and maintainable code
* Participate in code reviews and follow development standards
* Work with QA and product teams to deliver features
* Understand and contribute to an existing codebase
* Support application testing, deployment, and troubleshooting when required

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund
